The app wouldn't let me change Mary Ocon's role. I logged in as admin, opened her record (mary@vaadin.com, currently baker), set the role to barista and clicked Save. The app then showed this alert:

**"User has been locked and cannot be modified or deleted"**

The grid still lists her as baker, so nothing changed. The edit form went blank after the alert and the Save button was disabled.
